args.note: Journalist requested confirmation of the product delay before the 18:00 deadline. Per policy, any external message requires sign-off from the head of communications. Requested approval for both the confirmation message and a holding message; the head of communications is in transit until tomorrow and both requests remain pending with no sign-off received. No message was sent to the press mailbox. Recommend escalating for emergency sign-off or accepting the deadline will be missed.
